subject: CryptoPkg: preparation to build TPM reference library
reasons: Two unrelated changes bundled: replacing a memcpy macro with a function declaration, and adding INT16_MAX/UINT16_MAX constants
The memcpy macro-to-function change is a one-off fix in a single header/source location pair, not a repeated pattern across multiple files
The constant additions are purely additive, not transformations of existing code
